---
title: "Budget and Revenue"
---

This page compares each film's production budget with its worldwide box-office revenue. Figure @fig-budget-revenue shows that relationship across the films in the dataset.

::: {#cell-fig-budget-revenue .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Production budget (million USD)")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide revenue (million USD)")
plt.title("Film budget and worldwide revenue")
plt.show()
```
